name: @avidia/mastery
description: Adaptive mastery engine and intelligent study scheduler (M8): the deterministic, versioned mastery-update algorithm (TypeScript mirror of the SQL implementation), explainable spaced-review scheduling, exam-proximity urgency, the transparent study-priority model, the next-best-concept recommendation engine with reason codes, and mastery-appropriate question selection with session diversity. Pure functions only — no database access, no AI calls, no node built-ins — safe for the web bundle.
